[b][h3]New Game！！！MilkwaySubway[/h3][/b]


Between stars, galaxies, and nebulae，everything is shrouded in the void. At the tip of the warp, the starlight is constant, humming an unfinished  rhyme. the vast galaxy, flowing towards the ashes.  the universe sent a gift，a miracle.A perfect 20-sided body about 3m high landed silently and peacefully on the pole. COSMIC, the largest non-governmental scientific organization on the plane, quickly blocked the site and formed a team to explore and study it. Sudden celestial strange glory, the black hole civilization's  warning, the anti-technology side of the revolutionary crisis, the deranged experimental report. As a scientific researcher, you, miallai, will get to know your companions and work together to explore the unknown step by step and break through the limitations of spacetime to see the bright civilization.


The new game is a 2.5D horizontal role-playing game with the theme of physical SF. In this game, you can ship in a GL cp, feel the charm of the physical discipline, reveal an amazing SF world.

notes.title: 游戏引导性优化
notes.content:
让游戏流程更加流畅，不那么容易卡关了
-修复了成为服务员之后再次返回地下室游戏卡关的BUG
-删除了时间会流逝的插件，不会出现还没探索完就到下一检查点而导致卡关的BUG
-修复了地下室碰撞箱问题
-修复了书架碰撞箱问题
